Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essentials:
- Passports and travel documents (including copies)
- Boarding passes (digital and printed)
- Credit cards and cash (local currency - US dollars)
- Phone charger and power bank
- Universal travel adapter (Hawaii uses Type A/B outlets)
- Medications and prescriptions (with copies of prescriptions)
- First aid kit

Clothing:
- Swimwear (2-3 pieces)
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, tank tops, shorts)
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Long-sleeved shirts (for sun protection and bug bites)
- Hiking pants or quick-dry pants
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals or flip-flops
- Dressy outfit (for the luau and special occasions)
- Hat or cap (for sun protection)
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins - or rent at the location)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Water shoes (for rocky beaches)
- Dry bag or waterproof backpack
- Inflatable float or body board (optional)

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Sturdy hiking shoes or trail runners
- Backpack (for day hikes)
- Water bottle (at least 1L capacity)
- Hat with brim (for sun protection)
- Insect repellent (for jungle areas)
- Rain jacket or poncho (Hawaii weather can change quickly)
- Gloves (for handling plants or rough terrain)

Electronics:
- Camera (digital or film)
- Memory cards and extra batteries
- Portable speaker (for beach or hotel use)
- E-reader or tablet (for entertainment)
- Headphones or earbuds

Toiletries & Personal Care:
- Travel-sized shampoo, conditioner, and body wash
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor and shaving cream
- Makeup and skincare products (travel-sized)
- Hairbrush or comb
- Feminine hygiene products (if needed)
- Contact lenses and solution (if applicable)

Miscellaneous:
- Guidebook or travel app (for Hawaii)
- Small notebook and pen
- Snacks (for long drives or hikes)
- Reusable water bottle
- Small lock (for securing luggage)
- Laundry bag
- Travel pillow (for long flights)
- Entertainment (books, games, etc.)

Special Considerations:
- For the luau: Consider bringing a lei or a traditional Hawaiian shirt
- For the North Shore road trip: Bring a camera for scenic views
- For the spa day: Pack a robe or towel if not provided
- For the shopping day: Bring a reusable shopping bag

Note: Hawaii has a tropical climate with warm temperatures year-round, but it can get cooler at higher elevations and in the evenings. Pack layers to accommodate changing conditions.
